behaviors.name: deterministic_stub_turn
behaviors.contract: A dependency-light perception request produces deterministic structured output and run artifacts without a live model.

behaviors.name: cited_fixture_retrieval
behaviors.contract: Fixture-backed retrieval is reproducible and returns ranked source-linked evidence.

behaviors.name: file_product_kag
behaviors.contract: The product graph can be built and queried locally with explicit provenance and citations; Neo4j is not required.

behaviors.name: honest_hybrid_degradation
behaviors.contract: A failed or empty graph stage yields an explicit bounded fallback, warnings, source evidence, and a traceable stressor receipt rather than false success.

behaviors.name: dry_run_action_fence
behaviors.contract: Intent-to-plan-to-action is deterministic, preserves intent and trace correlation, and emits no keyboard or mouse input by default.

behaviors.name: windows_session_and_capture_evidence
behaviors.contract: Windows acceptance can identify an ATM10 session, prefer DXcam capture, and artifact the selected source and degraded fallback.

behaviors.name: optional_provider_honesty
behaviors.contract: Unavailable model, store, voice, UI, or hardware providers fail at the use site and preserve a usable stub/replay or explicitly degraded turn.

behaviors.name: state_trace_separation
behaviors.contract: Mutable companion state is not used as a substitute for append-only turn and action evidence.

behaviors.name: public_safe_local_defaults
behaviors.contract: Default examples are loopback-safe, token-safe, free of workstation paths, and keep real automation disabled.

behaviors.name: provider_replaceability
behaviors.contract: Provider selection is explicit, optional dependencies are not loaded at core import time, and a provider can be replaced without changing the turn contract.

behaviors.name: powershell_product_edge
behaviors.contract: The supported Windows 11 lane remains launchable and verifiable from PowerShell 7 as separate acceptance evidence.

behaviors.name: negative_and_replay_evidence
behaviors.contract: Useful failure cases and prior trace shapes remain fixture-testable without live services, models, game windows, or network access.
